title: Appliance Repair Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control diagnosis, repair, maintenance, testing, and return to use through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete appliance repair equipment inspection report for appliances and utility connections. It connects manufacturer service information, approved scope, and customer authorization to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified appliance service technician must inspect appliances and utility connections against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Appliance Repair inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Do not infer whole-asset or whole-site condition from a limited, inaccessible, or unqualified inspection.

blocks.label: Inspection access and control readiness
items: Electrical supply isolated and verified before exposed work
Gas, water, steam, or other utility isolated when required
Stored heat, pressure, motion, and sharp-part exposure controlled
Floor, cabinetry, contents, and adjacent finishes protected
Refrigerant work routed to an appropriately certified technician
Replacement part compatibility verified before installation
Recall or manufacturer service notice checked when applicable
Customer kept from operating the appliance during controlled work
Leak, combustion, and ventilation concerns receive a stop-work response
Restoration test plan defined before utilities are reconnected

sections.title: Appliance Repair component and condition findings
sections.guidance: Record actual observations at requirement level rather than converting a checkmark into a conclusion.

blocks.label: Appliance Repair detailed inspection points
items: Power cord, plug, receptacle, disconnect, and visible wiring condition
Gas or fuel connection, shutoff, ignition, flame, and venting condition
Water supply, inlet, drain, hose, seal, and leak condition
Refrigerant circuit, tubing, coils, condensate, and airflow condition
Door, latch, hinge, gasket, interlock, and enclosure condition
Motor, fan, pump, belt, bearing, and other moving-part condition
Control panel, sensor, thermostat, display, and error history
Heating, cooling, washing, drying, or cycle performance
Mounting, leveling, clearances, anchorage, and anti-tip provisions
Safety devices, guards, labels, and required warnings

sections.title: Appliance Repair measurements, instruments, and evidence package
sections.guidance: Preserve readings and source evidence needed to reproduce the inspection decision.

blocks.label: Measurement, test, and instrument log
blocks.guidance: Applicable concepts include: Supply voltage or electrical reading, Operating current or resistance, Temperature rise, drop, or setpoint, Pressure, vacuum, or leak-test result, Cycle time, flow, or drain performance, Level, clearance, airflow, or vibration observation.

blocks.label: Available inspection evidence

Customer symptom description and timing
Displayed fault code or diagnostic log
Pre-work condition photographs
Meter, temperature, pressure, or leak-test result
Removed and installed part identifiers
Post-repair operating-cycle result
Manufacturer information or recall reference

sections.title: Appliance Repair inspection status and release decision
sections.guidance: Base the stated status on explicit findings, test limits, defect control, and qualified authorization.

blocks.label: Release and condition verification points
items: Reported symptom no longer present under the test condition
No visible leak, abnormal odor, smoke, spark, or overheating
Controls, indicators, and user interface respond correctly
Door, latch, interlock, guard, and cutoff operate correctly
Utilities and connections restored without abnormal condition
Appliance is level, stable, secured, and clear of obstruction
Work area and customer contents restored
Customer operating limitation and next action explained

sections.title: Appliance Repair equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This appliance repair equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when electrical, gas, refrigerant, water, combustion, structural, recall, or other unsafe condition is unresolved. A qualified appliance service or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
